name: Point-Based Neural Renderer Architecture
definition: A neural network that encodes rasterized point clouds from multiple input views, pools features with inductive bias for visibility and temporal smoothing, and decodes them to generate the final rendering.
summary: The Point-Based Neural Renderer is a differentiable module that fuses multiple input views to render novel viewpoints from 3D point clouds, ensuring temporal stability and view-invariance without retraining.
